key:config["dataPassword"],
iv:config["iv"]

iv:"ABCDEF1G34123412",

}

var ch_list = [];
var host = "https://mhimg.eshanyao.com/";

ch_list[i] = host+"showImage.php?url="+encodeURIComponent(list[i]);
}
else if (list[i].search(/^[a-z]\//i)==0) {
ch_list[i] = host+"showImage.php?url=https://images.dmzj.com/"+list[i];
}
else if (list[i].search(/^(http:|https:|ftp:|^)\/\//i)==0) {
ch_list[i] = list[i];
}
else {
ch_list[i] = host+chapterPath+list[i];
}
}
ch_list;
</js>

<js>

eval(result.match(/var chapterImages.*chapterPath = "([^"]*?)";/)[0]);
var decryptedStr=java.fns.AES_Decrypt(chapterImages, {
	key:"123456781234567G",
	iv:"ABCDEF1G34123412"
}, true);
var list = JSON.parse(decryptedStr.toString());
var piclist = [];
var host = "https://mhimg.eshanyao.com/";
for (var i=0; i<list.length; i++) {
if (list[i].search(/^https?:\/\/(images.dmzj.com|imgsmall.dmzj.com)/i)==0) {
piclist[i] = host+"showImage.php?url="+encodeURI(list[i]);
}
else if (list[i].search(/^[a-z]\//i)==0) {
piclist[i] = host+"showImage.php?url="+encodeURI("https://images.dmzj.com/"+list[i]);
}
else if (list[i].search(/^(http:|https:|ftp:|^)\/\//i)==0) {
piclist[i] = list[i];
}
else {
piclist[i] = host+chapterPath+list[i];
}
}
piclist
</js>@Header:{Referer:host}
